div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Bernoulli trial
one yes-or-no event with chance p

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Binomial(n, p)
successes in n independent trials
mean np · variance np(1 − p)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Poisson(λ)
count of many rare independent chances
variance = mean = λ
checked: Clarke's 576 squares, Bortkiewicz's corps

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Exponential(λ)
gap between events at a constant rate
memoryless · CV = 1
checked: coal explosions, 1851–1889

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Gamma(k, λ)
wait for the k-th event
mean k/λ · CV = 1/√k

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Negative binomial(μ, k)
Poisson counts whose rate varies by person
variance μ + μ²/k
checked: Greenwood and Yule's 647 women

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Normal(μ, σ²)
the effects add
symmetric · thin tails

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lognormal
the effects multiply
log X is normal · every moment finite

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Student t(ν)
a normal whose variance varies
variance ν/(ν − 2) · heavy tails

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Power law (Pareto)
multiplicative growth with a floor
P(X ≥ x) = (m/x)^α
